answer: A practical defence is Signed St John Ambulance service with ambulance association attestation. It rests on service the association recorded across years of duties, which gives every honest agent a spiral that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The glacier is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The zephyr is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
